title: Rast i zadržavanje
description: Aktivni korisnici, novi i povratni, kohortno zadržavanje i izvori.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(if(user_id != '', user_id, device_id)) FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND toDate(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = today()
SELECT uniqExact(if(user_id != '', user_id, device_id)) FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
SELECT uniqExact(if(user_id != '', user_id, device_id)) FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

panels.title: Ljepljivost DAU/MAU

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * avg(d) / greatest((SELECT uniqExact(if(user_id != '', user_id, device_id)) FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY), 1), 1) FROM (SELECT toDate(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') AS day, uniqExact(if(user_id != '', user_id, device_id)) AS d FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY day)

panels.description: Prosječni dnevni korisnici kroz mjesečne, zadnjih 30 dana. 20 % znači da se prosječni korisnik vraća 6 dana u mjesecu.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM (SELECT who, min(ts) AS first_ts, argMinIf(JSONExtractString(props, 'referrer'), ts, event = 'session_start') AS ref, argMinIf(JSONExtractString(props, 'utm_source'), ts, event = 'session_start') AS utm, argMin(platform, ts) AS plat, argMin(country, ts) AS drz FROM (SELECT e.*, if(e.user_id != '', e.user_id, if(d.u != '', d.u, e.device_id)) AS who FROM analytics.events AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT device_id, any(user_id) AS u FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND user_id != '' GROUP BY device_id) AS d USING device_id WHERE e.app = 'domovina.ai') GROUP BY who) WHERE $__timeFilter(first_ts)

panels.title: Vratilo se (od novih)

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * countIf(days > 1) / greatest(count(), 1), 1) FROM (SELECT who, uniqExact(toDate(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb')) AS days, min(ts) AS f FROM (SELECT e.*, if(e.user_id != '', e.user_id, if(d.u != '', d.u, e.device_id)) AS who FROM analytics.events AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT device_id, any(user_id) AS u FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND user_id != '' GROUP BY device_id) AS d USING device_id WHERE e.app = 'domovina.ai') GROUP BY who) WHERE $__timeFilter(f)

panels.description: Novi korisnici iz razdoblja koji su bili aktivni barem još jedan dan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') AS time, platform, uniqExact(if(user_id != '', user_id, device_id)) AS korisnika FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, platform ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfDay(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') AS time, uniqExactIf(who, toDate(f.first_ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = toDate(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb')) AS novi, uniqExactIf(who, toDate(f.first_ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') < toDate(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb')) AS povratni FROM (SELECT e.*, if(e.user_id != '', e.user_id, if(d.u != '', d.u, e.device_id)) AS who FROM analytics.events AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT device_id, any(user_id) AS u FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND user_id != '' GROUP BY device_id) AS d USING device_id WHERE e.app = 'domovina.ai' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)) AS x LEFT JOIN (SELECT who, min(ts) AS first_ts, argMinIf(JSONExtractString(props, 'referrer'), ts, event = 'session_start') AS ref, argMinIf(JSONExtractString(props, 'utm_source'), ts, event = 'session_start') AS utm, argMin(platform, ts) AS plat, argMin(country, ts) AS drz FROM (SELECT e.*, if(e.user_id != '', e.user_id, if(d.u != '', d.u, e.device_id)) AS who FROM analytics.events AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT device_id, any(user_id) AS u FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND user_id != '' GROUP BY device_id) AS d USING device_id WHERE e.app = 'domovina.ai') GROUP BY who) AS f USING who GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Zadržavanje po tjednim kohortama (%)

targets.rawSql: SELECT formatDateTime(w0, '%d.%m.%Y.') AS kohorta, count() AS novih, if(w0 + INTERVAL 1 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 1 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T1`, if(w0 + INTERVAL 2 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 2 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T2`, if(w0 + INTERVAL 3 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 3 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T3`, if(w0 + INTERVAL 4 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 4 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T4`, if(w0 + INTERVAL 5 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 5 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T5`, if(w0 + INTERVAL 6 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 6 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T6`, if(w0 + INTERVAL 7 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 7 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T7`, if(w0 + INTERVAL 8 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 8 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T8`, if(w0 + INTERVAL 9 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 9 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T9`, if(w0 + INTERVAL 10 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 10 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T10`, if(w0 + INTERVAL 11 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 11 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T11`, if(w0 + INTERVAL 12 WEEK <= toMonday(today()), round(100 * countIf(has(ws, w0 + INTERVAL 12 WEEK)) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `T12` FROM (SELECT who, min(toMonday(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb')) AS w0, groupUniqArray(toMonday(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb')) AS ws FROM (SELECT e.*, if(e.user_id != '', e.user_id, if(d.u != '', d.u, e.device_id)) AS who FROM analytics.events AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT device_id, any(user_id) AS u FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND user_id != '' GROUP BY device_id) AS d USING device_id WHERE e.app = 'domovina.ai') GROUP BY who) WHERE w0 >= toMonday(today() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK) GROUP BY w0 ORDER BY w0 DESC

panels.description: Red = tjedan prvog dolaska. T1 = postotak koji je bio aktivan tjedan kasnije, T2 dva tjedna kasnije… Prazne ćelije su tjedni koji još nisu prošli.

panels.title: Odakle dolaze novi korisnici

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(ref = '', '(izravno)', domainWithoutWWW(ref)) AS izvor, utm AS utm_source, count() AS novih, round(100 * countIf(r.days > 1) / count(), 1) AS vratilo_se_pct FROM (SELECT who, min(ts) AS first_ts, argMinIf(JSONExtractString(props, 'referrer'), ts, event = 'session_start') AS ref, argMinIf(JSONExtractString(props, 'utm_source'), ts, event = 'session_start') AS utm, argMin(platform, ts) AS plat, argMin(country, ts) AS drz FROM (SELECT e.*, if(e.user_id != '', e.user_id, if(d.u != '', d.u, e.device_id)) AS who FROM analytics.events AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT device_id, any(user_id) AS u FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND user_id != '' GROUP BY device_id) AS d USING device_id WHERE e.app = 'domovina.ai') GROUP BY who) AS f LEFT JOIN (SELECT who, uniqExact(toDate(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb')) AS days FROM (SELECT e.*, if(e.user_id != '', e.user_id, if(d.u != '', d.u, e.device_id)) AS who FROM analytics.events AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT device_id, any(user_id) AS u FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND user_id != '' GROUP BY device_id) AS d USING device_id WHERE e.app = 'domovina.ai') GROUP BY who) AS r USING who WHERE $__timeFilter(first_ts) GROUP BY izvor, utm_source ORDER BY novih DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Izvor prve sesije i koliko se njih vratilo barem još jedan dan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT plat AS platforma, drz AS drzava, count() AS novih FROM (SELECT who, min(ts) AS first_ts, argMinIf(JSONExtractString(props, 'referrer'), ts, event = 'session_start') AS ref, argMinIf(JSONExtractString(props, 'utm_source'), ts, event = 'session_start') AS utm, argMin(platform, ts) AS plat, argMin(country, ts) AS drz FROM (SELECT e.*, if(e.user_id != '', e.user_id, if(d.u != '', d.u, e.device_id)) AS who FROM analytics.events AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT device_id, any(user_id) AS u FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND user_id != '' GROUP BY device_id) AS d USING device_id WHERE e.app = 'domovina.ai') GROUP BY who) WHERE $__timeFilter(first_ts) GROUP BY plat, drz ORDER BY novih DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Kada su svi aktivni (dan u tjednu × sat)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ['pon','uto','sri','čet','pet','sub','ned'][toDayOfWeek(ts, 0, 'Europe/Zagreb')] AS dan, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 0) AS `00`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 1) AS `01`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 2) AS `02`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 3) AS `03`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 4) AS `04`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 5) AS `05`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 6) AS `06`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 7) AS `07`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 8) AS `08`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 9) AS `09`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 10) AS `10`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 11) AS `11`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 12) AS `12`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 13) AS `13`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 14) AS `14`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 15) AS `15`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 16) AS `16`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 17) AS `17`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 18) AS `18`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 19) AS `19`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 20) AS `20`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 21) AS `21`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 22) AS `22`, countIf(toHour(ts, 'Europe/Zagreb') = 23) AS `23` FROM analytics.events WHERE app = 'domovina.ai' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event = 'screen_view' GROUP BY toDayOfWeek(ts, 0, 'Europe/Zagreb') AS d, dan ORDER BY d

panels.description: Broj otvorenih ekrana po danu u tjednu i satu (Zagreb).
